function serpbearPrompt({body,domain}){if(typeof domain!=='string'||!domain.trim()||domain==='YOUR_DOMAIN')throw Error('Configure domain');if(!body||typeof body!=='object'||!Array.isArray(body.keywords))throw Error('SerpBear did not return keywords');if(!body.keywords.length)return{hasKeywords:false,messages:[]};const rows=body.keywords.map(k=>{if(!k||typeof k.keyword!=='string'||!k.keyword.trim()||(k.position!=null&&(!Number.isFinite(k.position)||k.position<0))||(k.history!=null&&(typeof k.history!=='object'||Array.isArray(k.history)))||typeof k.domain!=='string'||k.domain!==domain||(k.url!=null&&typeof k.url!=='string'))throw Error('Invalid keyword data');const position=k.position??0,entries=Object.entries(k.history??{});if(entries.some(([date,v])=>!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date)||!Number.isFinite(v)||v<0))throw Error('Invalid keyword history');const positions=entries.sort(([a],[b])=>a.localeCompare(b)).slice(-7).map(x=>x[1]).filter(x=>x>0),avg=positions.length?Math.round(positions.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/positions.length*10)/10:null,trend=avg===null||position===0?'not enough ranking data':position<avg?'improving':position>avg?'declining':'stable';return{keyword:k.keyword,currentPosition:position,averagePosition:avg,trend,url:k.url||'not ranking'}});const content=`You are an SEO expert. Analyze this keyword ranking data for ${domain}:\n${JSON.stringify(rows)}\nSummarize rankings in a table, identify improvements and issues, and suggest actions.`;return{hasKeywords:true,messages:[{role:'user',content}]}}

const result=serpbearPrompt({body:$input.first().json,domain:$('Configure SerpBear').first().json.domain});return result.hasKeywords?[{json:result}]:[];

function reportRow({completion,blog}){if(typeof blog!=='string'||!blog.trim()||blog==='YOUR_BLOG_NAME')throw Error('Configure the blog name');const text=completion?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content;if(typeof text!=='string'||!text.trim())throw Error('OpenRouter returned no report text');if(completion.choices[0].finish_reason==='length')throw Error('OpenRouter report was truncated');return {row:{Date:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),Note:text,Blog:blog}};}

return {json:reportRow({completion:$json,blog:"YOUR_BLOG_NAME"})};

function config({instance,domain}){if(typeof instance!=='string'||instance.includes('YOUR_SERPBEAR_HOST')||typeof domain!=='string'||domain==='YOUR_DOMAIN'||!domain.trim())throw Error('Configure SerpBear instance and domain');if(!/^https:\/\/[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9])?(?::[0-9]{1,5})?\/api\/keywords$/i.test(instance))throw Error('Use an HTTPS SerpBear /api/keywords URL');return{url:instance,domain}}

return [{json:config({instance:'https://YOUR_SERPBEAR_HOST/api/keywords',domain:'YOUR_DOMAIN'})}];
